assumptions.choice: The order size is 1% of current broker portfolio value divided by the signal bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires 1% of total trading capital but does not define the valuation moment or fractional-share handling.

assumptions.choice: No European-equity, liquidity, or whole-universe ATR-quartile exclusion is applied.
assumptions.reason: The fixed harness supplies only one AAPL daily feed and no universe-level liquidity or future-period ATR data.

assumptions.choice: A stop sell and an OCO limit sell are placed after entry execution using the executed entry price and ATR captured on the entry signal bar.
assumptions.reason: This directly implements exits when the specified stop-loss or 2% take-profit price is reached.
